text: For the germline cohort I'm going with GRCh37 (human_g1k_v37), not GRCh38. Our legacy 2019 samples were all called on 37 and we need the joint-genotyping to be comparable. Switching builds mid-cohort would invalidate the comparison.
makes sense. what about the base quality filter?
min-base-quality-score 20. 30 was dropping too many real hets in the low-coverage exomes. 20 is the GATK default and matches the 2019 run, so we stay consistent.
